system.description:
Beginning at 18th Level, you learn to unleash massive surges of chakra, augmenting your strength to monstrous levels. You increase the number of Byakugou Seals you can maintain by 2, increasing your maximum to 8. You gain the following abilities for which you can spend Yin Seals to use.

Tiger Lily Drive. As an Action, you can spend 3 Byakugou Seals to dash with the intensity of a missile, moving in a 60-foot line, passing through enemies like a living warhead. Each creature you pass through must make a Dexterity saving throw vs your Taijutsu (or Ninjutsu, your choice) save DC. On a failed save, they take your [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage] + 3d6, are pushed 20 feet in a direction of your choice (excluding upwards), are knocked prone, and must spend their full movement to stand before the end of their next turn, or half as much on a success.

Camellia Rupture. In place of an attack, you make when you take the Attack action, you can spend 3 Byakugou Seals. When you do, make a melee Taijutsu attack that collapses the ground underneath you from the force of the strike alone. On a hit, you deal [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage] + [Unarmed Damage] + 3d12, ignoring resistance and treating immunity as resistance and the damaged creature must make a Constitution saving throw vs your Taijutsu (or Ninjutsu, your choice) save DC, being Stunned until the end of their next turn on a failed save or no further effect on a successful save.

Orchid Pulse. As a Bonus action, you can spend 3 Byakugou Seals to release a pulse of Medical chakra reinforcing your allies on the front lines. All willing creatures of your choice in a 20-foot radius, centered on you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to twice your Channeled Healing bonus, end one condition of your choice, and gain immunity to Bruised, Bleed, Daze, Slowed, Blinded or Stunned until the end of your next turn.
